prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1319; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you understand this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Good. Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.

A: I was driving on a two-lane road in Katy, heading toward the shopping center. It was a clear afternoon and traffic was light.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what was the other vehicle doing?

A: I was going straight. The other car came across into my lane. I think it was trying to pass something, but I'm not sure.

Q: How fast were you going when the impact occurred?

A: I'd guess maybe twenty-five miles an hour. I had already slowed down a little because of a stop sign ahead.

Q: Did you apply your brakes before the impact?

A: Yes, I braked as hard as I could, but there wasn't enough time.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Where did you first feel pain or notice an injury?

A: My right shoulder hit the door and the seatbelt pulled hard across my chest. I felt a sharp pain right away, and by the next morning it was much worse.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then.

Q: Do you have any pre-existing problems with that shoulder?

A: No, not that I can recall. I play some tennis, but I hadn't had any problems before this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble lifting things and sleeping on that side. I'm hoping to get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
